description: Erection of single storey workshop and garage for the  ground floor flat
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The building as extended shall be used only for purposes incidental to the enjoyment of the Ground Floor Flat at 67 Heston Road as a single family house and shall not include primary residential accommodation in the form of living or bedrooms, w/c facilities, toilets, bathroom or kitchen, nor shall it be used as a separate dwelling or for business purposes.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Unnumbered Design and Access Statement, 0.01_SITE PLAN_1.500, 1.01_EXISTING_GROUND FLOOR PLAN, 0.02_SITE PLAN_1.1250, 1.02_EXISTING_ROOF PLAN, 1.11_EXISTING_SECTION AA, 1.12_EXISTING_SECTION BB, 1.21_EXISTING_ELEVATIONS, 1.22_EXISTING_ELEVATIONS, 1.24_EXISTING_ELEVATIONS, 2.01_PROPOSED_GROUND FLOOR PLAN, 2.02_PROPOSED_ROOF PLAN, 2.11_PROPOSED_SECTION AA, 2.12_PROPOSED_SECTION BB, 2.13_PROPOSED_SECTION CC, 2.21_PROPOSED_ELEVATIONS_GARDEN, 2.22_PROPOSED_ELEVATIONS_Side_1, 2.23_PROPOSED_ELEVATIONS_2 PROPOSED ELEVATIONS and 2.24_PROPOSED_ELEVATIONS_STREET Received on 08 April 2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
